positive_terms: (Local) ecological threshold and entity-specific allocation were taken into consideration when setting water and marine resources target
水目标是否考虑生态阈值

(Local) ecological threshold and entity-specific allocation were taken into consideration when setting water and marine resources target。水目标是否考虑生态阈值。目标对象、区域、期限和水量概念分别明确；取水、排水和耗水目标不可互換。生态阈值是水生态条件，不是货币金额。
